invariants: customer_id must be unique across all customers
customer_name must not be null or empty
customer_email must be unique across all customers and must conform to RFC 5322 email format
product_id must be unique across all products
product_name must not be null or empty
product_category_id must reference an existing category_id
product_stock_quantity must be non-negative
order_id must be unique across all orders
order_customer_id must reference an existing customer_id
order_status must be one of ['pending', 'confirmed', 'shipped', 'cancelled']
order_total must be non-negative
order_items must be a list of objects where each item has a product_id referencing an existing product_id and quantity must be positive
invoice_id must be unique across all invoices
invoice_order_id must reference an existing order_id
invoice_customer_id must reference an existing customer_id
invoice_status must be one of ['draft', 'sent', 'paid']
invoice_total must equal the sum of order_items' product_price multiplied by quantity
reserved_stock for a product must equal the sum of quantities of all confirmed orders containing that product
reserved_stock cannot exceed the product's available stock quantity
product_available_stock must equal product_stock_quantity minus reserved_stock
each order item's quantity must not exceed the product's reserved_stock for that product
order_items must not contain duplicate product_ids for the same order
invoice_total must not exceed the order_total
